source.no_rerender: frames deterministic; full lobe measurements were retained per level — the Phase 0 MISSING item is computed, not re-measured

floor_rule: response vs reference L0 must clear floor x 2.0; under-floor levels are not levels; pairs with < 3 surviving common levels are NOT_COMPUTABLE and cannot carry 1a validity (a noise axis diverges for free — that is not evidence)
caveats: raking axes borrow the BAKED relief-subject floors on a flat matte subject — the flat SHADOW floor was FLOOR_NOT_MEASURABLE; subject mismatch recorded
EDGE_HIGHLIGHT_RESPONSE is floor-ineligible (0.27991) — its pairs can only appear where levels genuinely clear 2x that floor

GRANULARITY here is measured on the RAKING rig frames (as the original sweep did), not the mirror-source texture rig that carries the counted GRANULARITY axis — the new Phase 3 sweeps measure GRANULARITY on the counted instrument

floor_operationalization.A_per_level_gate_vs_reference_L0: the analysis in full_matrix — levels gated individually; FAILS the negative control (the known-good flake_density divergence collapses to NOT_COMPUTABLE because a mid-range reference hides genuine response)
floor_operationalization.B_axis_span_qualification: an axis joins the matrix only if its total sweep response clears floor x 2.0; rho over all levels for qualifying axes; PASSES the negative control (the genuine flake divergence COHERENCE|ENV 0.3916 survives, the sub-floor divergences are correctly excluded)
floor_operationalization.selected: B — selected BY the negative control, not by outcome: the micronormal verdict is INVARIANT to the choice (SWEEP_DEGENERATE_UNDER_DRIVER under A, under B, and with no floor filtering at all: 0/36 divergent pairs unfiltered)
floor_operationalization.self_approval_flag: the operationalization is my reading of the owner's floor sentence — listed in the Phase 5 self-approval check

no_floor_sensitivity.meaning: the degeneracy is not an artifact of any floor rule

raking_sweep_1c_reexam_span_B.consequence_1c: the raking third-channel void was built on a DEGENERATE reading: no qualifying pair diverges under the single monotone driver, so the 1.0 that voided the channel carries no information under the amended law. UN-VOIDING the channel is an AMENDMENT_INDUCED_IMPROVEMENT — held for the owner, NOT committed; the void STANDS until the owner rules.

constant_vector_defect.RAKING_SHADOW_FRACTION: bit-constant 0.089844 across all 12 levels — the original record's 1.0 vs GRANULARITY was an undefined-correlation artifact, superseded in place in raking_rig/sweep/sweep_result.json; generalizes Phase 5's silent-zero check: a bit-CONSTANT axis is a non-response of the same class as an all-zero axis
